risks.title: Hydrocarbon price dependency and market volatility
risks.score_rationale: Core risk for E&P (31-52), implicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements and definitions (12-month average prices). Strong language on economic sensitivity. Stable but structural trend. Maximum weight for a major oil company.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and regulation in producing countries
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly dedicated to risks. Eni operates in unstable regions (Africa, Middle East implicit). Strong language on contractual dependency and concession renewals. Trend up (geopolitical context 2023-2024). Critical weight for diversified E&P portfolio.

risks.title: Energy transition and hydrocarbon asset obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in business structure (Enilive, Plenitude, renewables). Moderate but present language in forward-looking statements on 'industries in which Eni operates'. Trend up (ESG pressures, EU regulation). High weight for long-term strategy.

risks.title: Increased competition in natural gas and LNG
risks.score_rationale: Item 4 'Global Gas & LNG Portfolio' (53-56) highlights competitive position. Moderate language on 'competitive position' based on market share estimates. Trend up (new LNG entrants, LNG spot market). Significant weight for gas segment.

risks.title: Operational risks and safety in deepwater exploration
risks.score_rationale: Item 4 E&P (31-52) details deep waters (>200m) and FPSO. Technical language on development and drilling. Stable trend but high potential incidents. Moderate weight but major reputational and financial impact.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and environmental sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Item 4 'Regulation of Eni's businesses' (80-90) and 'Environmental matters' (70-79) are explicit. Moderate but detailed language on ARERA, EU Taxonomy. Trend up (tightening EU standards, CSRD). High weight for European operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and disruption of critical systems
risks.score_rationale: Item 16K 'Cybersecurity' (184) mentioned but content not provided. Minimal language in extract. Trend new/up (growing threats in energy sector). Moderate weight but high potential operational impact.

risks.title: Dependency on partners and joint ventures
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in PSA and concession contracts (glossary). Moderate language on 'agreements with partners'. Stable trend. Moderate weight for E&P portfolio in co-development.
